lines: After working for the King for many years, researching spells that contribute to the kingdom's peace and prosperity, <color=#8836E0>Altheia the Witch</color> gained the overwhelming support of the citizens. The King grew wary, believing Altheia's influence a threat to his absolute authority. The King lured the unwitting witch into a trap and imrprisoned her in the deepest darkest dungeons, assigning the formidable Sphinx as her jailor. Altheia vowed to escape her imprisonment and get revenge on the proudful King.
